finalReport: The agent inspected three tagged crates: Cargo 07 cleared for dispatch; Cargo 12 surface abrasion on north face with intact seal; Cargo 18 intact seal awaiting inventory scan. It staged Cargo 07 at [6,0.55,2], viewed the arm placement image and independently verified the position through drone telemetry. It completed 96/96 analytic floor cells, while explicitly declining to certify elevated or occluded inventory. The arm was home and empty, the drone landed at [2.583,0.4,-18], and all leases were released. It used camera images, sensor limits and unknown floor cells to choose its route, including changing approaches after rack-face images. It made 90 recorded MCP calls excluding 50 aggregated movement waits. No MCP errors, unavailable images or final export errors occurred.
agentAttestation: The agent confirmed no repository source, AGENTS.md, docs, other sessions files, spectator DOM or snapshots were read during decisions; only own MCP results and returned JPEG paths.
